default.$description: The hairline — every panel edge, table rule, input border, card border, divider. The only border width in this system that is a themeable ROLE rather than one component's internal geometry: re-point it to --border-width-200 and the whole kit gets heavier chrome in one move. Deliberately the only tier-2 width. An `emphasis` sibling was considered and left out: the 2px borders in the kit are all micro-geometry (spinner rings, the kbd keycap lip, a chevron built from two borders), and SPEC.md is explicit that inventing a role nobody can point at is not licensed by the fact that some theme might want it.
